entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.

The cited Benziger proper page prints all 23 body words and the abbreviated cue Qui tecum. It does not print the selected full conclusion or Amen; those are separately supported by RG 115 c and the declared ritual-boundary use.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.

locator.section: RG 115 c: conclusion addressed to the Father with mention of the Son near the end; complete Qui tecum formula through Amen

entries.claim: RG 115 c supplies the full conclusion Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus, per omnia saecula saeculorum. Amen. This use supports the separately declared expansion of the proper page’s Qui tecum cue, not a claim that the proper page prints the full formula or the selected house accents.
